# Small Store Dashboard Plan

A simple monthly dashboard should answer three questions fast: how many orders came in, how much revenue was earned, and whether returns are rising or falling. For a non-technical manager, keep labels plain, units visible, and trends easy to scan.

## Dashboard Layout and Key Metrics

**Top KPI cards**
- **Total Orders:** 565
- **Total Revenue:** **$44,500**
- **Average Orders / Month:** **141**
- **Average Revenue / Month:** **$11,125**
- **Average Return Rate:** **4.2%**

**3 charts to include**
- **Monthly Orders Trend** — line chart with Jan to Apr
- **Monthly Revenue Trend** — line or bar chart with Jan to Apr
- **Return Rate Trend** — line chart with Jan to Apr

**Monthly data for the charts**

| Month | Orders | Revenue | Return Rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Jan | 120 | 9600 | 3.5% |
| Feb | 135 | 10800 | 4.1% |
| Mar | 160 | 12400 | 5.0% |
| Apr | 150 | 11700 | 4.2% |

## Manager-Friendly Chart Labels and Insights

**Recommended chart labels**
- Chart 1 title: **Orders by Month**
- Chart 2 title: **Revenue by Month**
- Chart 3 title: **Return Rate by Month**
- X-axis: **Month**
- Y-axis for orders: **Number of Orders**
- Y-axis for revenue: **Revenue ($)**
- Y-axis for returns: **Return Rate (%)**

**4 simple insights**
- Orders and revenue both rose from January to March, then dipped slightly in April.
- **March was the strongest month** for both orders and revenue.
- Return rate increased from **3.5% in January** to **5.0% in March**, then improved to **4.2% in April**.
- Revenue grew overall across the period, suggesting sales momentum stayed healthy even with higher returns.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: View KPI layout] https://www.notion.so/templates/dashboard
Action: [Button: Build chart mockup] https://www.canva.com/templates/search/dashboard/
Action: [Button: Create spreadsheet] https://www.google.com/sheets/about/

## Sources

- Metric calculations based on the monthly data provided in your request
- Chart naming and dashboard readability guidance: https://www.nngroup.com/articles/dashboard-design/
